blocks.text: Carboxylic acids woh organic compounds hain jin ke molecules mein carboxyl functional group (–COOH) hota hai. Carboxylic acids ka general structure (aam banawat) neeche hai.

blocks.alt: Aam banawat R-C(=O)-OH, label carboxylic acids.
blocks.caption: Carboxylic acids ki aam banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 108 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids ki aam misalein: methanoic acid (formic acid, cheentiyon mein), ethanoic acid (acetic acid, sirke mein) aur butanoic acid (butyric acid, basi (rancid) makhan mein).

Chhote (lower) carboxylic acids aam taur par room temperature par liquids hain aur in ke boiling points oonche hain. Is ki wajah in ki hydrogen bond banane ki salahiyat hai. Ethanoic acid ka melting point 17 °C aur boiling point 118 °C hai. Is ka melting point room temperature (25 °C) ke qareeb hai, isi liye yeh sardiyon mein jam jata hai. Khalis ethanoic acid ki thos (solid) shakal ko glacial acetic acid kehte hain kyun ke yeh glacier (barf ke tode) jaisi dikhti hai. Hydrogen bond banane ki wajah se chhote acids, yani methanoic acid aur ethanoic acid, paani mein ghul jate hain.

blocks.alt: Ethanoic acid ke do molecules, H3C-C(=O)-OH aur HO-C(=O)-CH3, aik ring mein aamne saamne. Har aik ka C=O oxygen (delta-) doosre ke O-H hydrogen (delta+) se dash wale hydrogen bond se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Hydrogen bonding se banne wali acetic acid ki dimeric (jore wali) shakal (kitab ke PDF safha 108 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har molecule ka C=O oxygen (δ⁻) doosre molecule ke O–H wale hydrogen (δ⁺) ko kheenchta hai. Is tarah do hydrogen bonds (dash wali lakeerein) do molecules ko aik jora (dimer) bana dete hain. Isi wajah se ethanoic acid ka boiling point ooncha hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke label mein 'Dimeric from' chhapa hai; sahi 'Dimeric form' (jore wali shakal) hai.

Lambi chain wale aliphatic monocarboxylic acids ko fatty acids kehte hain. Stearic acid, palmitic acid aur oleic acid nabati (vegetable) oils mein triglycerides ki shakal mein milte hain. Yeh apni lambi hydrophobic (paani se door bhagne wali) alkyl chains ki wajah se paani mein nahi ghulte.
Palmitic acid (C₁₆H₃₂O₂) aik lambi chain wala carboxylic acid hai jo palm oil mein bari miqdar mein milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethanoic acid ka boiling point ethanal se kaheen zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid ke molecules apne –OH aur C=O groups se aapas mein hydrogen bonds banate hain (dimers). Ethanal mein O–H nahi, is liye us ke molecules aapas mein hydrogen bond nahi bana sakte.

items: Carboxylic acids: R–COOH; misalein methanoic, ethanoic, butanoic acid.
Hydrogen bonding: oonche boiling points, dimers; chhote acids paani mein ghulte hain.
Ethanoic acid: m.p. 17 °C, b.p. 118 °C; thos shakal glacial acetic acid.
Fatty acids: lambi chains, paani mein nahi ghulte.
